channel.title: Violations Watch: Myanmar
channel.description: New incidents reported in Myanmar. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Myanmar military airstrikes hit Swan Re bridge and Swan Re village, Ann Township, Rakhine (partisan local outlet)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Swan Re, Ann Township, Rakhine, Myanmar. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike, Destruction of property. Alleged perpetrator: Myanmar military (Tatmadaw). Disputed or caveats: Single partisan outlet (Global Arakan Network); no casualty figures. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0622

item.title: Myanmar military destroys two bridges with explosives and airstrikes; naval artillery burns seven homes in Rakhine (Narinjara)

item.title: Myanmar military airstrike on Byala displacement camp, Ponnagyun Township, Rakhine: 8–12 displaced people killed, at least 18 injured (per witnesses and local media)
item.description: Unverified lead (Critical priority). Byala IDP camp, Ponnagyun Township, Rakhine, Myanmar. Types: Air / drone / artillery strike, Killing of civilians, Forced displacement. Alleged perpetrator: Myanmar military (Tatmadaw). Reported casualties: 8-12 killed, 18+ injured. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: Death toll rose from 8 (initial reports) to 12; figures from witnesses and local media. 14 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0609

item.title: NLTA report: Rakhine (Arakan) recorded the highest civilian death toll from mass-killing incidents in Myanmar in Q3 2026
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Rakhine, Myanmar. Types: Killing of civilians, Mass atrocity / genocide. Disputed or caveats: Aggregate figures from a single monitoring report; per-incident detail not in the summary. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0538
